Reasoning: This stage keeps the marker held while inserting it axially into the pen_holder. I use object_grasped with a gripper_closed condition to represent maintaining the already-closed grasp without issuing another close_gripper command. The axis_align term maintains the marker +y length axis bipolar with the pen_holder +z opening axis within 5 degrees. The directional_move term encodes the required straight insertion motion of the gripped marker along pen_holder -z by 0.155 m with 0.01 m tolerance; its condition includes both geometry and manipulator_high_effort to represent stopping either on geometric insertion progress or on a firm axial insertion stop. Because only one position operator is allowed, the explicit pen_holder +z offset target of 0.0685 m is not separately emitted as a reach_point; it is treated as the intended equivalent endpoint of the specified 0.155 m insertion from the start-of-stage pre-insertion pose. The API cannot directly represent gripper effort consistency without stall, fingertip-to-marker relative transform preservation, lateral-vs-axial contact force discrimination, loss-of-grasp/slip detection beyond object_grasped, or no-progress stall monitoring, so those are noted but omitted.
